name: Teardown: Multiplayer
summary:
This update turns Teardown into a fully destructible playground for up to 12 players. Team up to tackle the campaign in co-op, jump into competitive modes like Deathmatch and Capture the Flag or unleash pure creative chaos in Sandbox Mode across every map.

With 70+ multiplayer-ready community mods already live and more being added, the possibilities are nearly limitless. New game modes, custom maps, wild rule sets and experimental tools.
